title: Practice 10: Where to: в and на

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Ты всё равно что из огня да в ___ (полымя, acc. sg.) попал.
exercises.prompt: It looks like you've gone out of the frying pan and into the fire.
exercises.why: **полымя → полымя** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -мя. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. полымя · — · — · полымя · полымем · —; pl. — · — · — · — · — · —.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я устроился на ___ (работа, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: I got a job.
exercises.why: **работа → работу** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. работа · работы · работе · работу · работой · работе; pl. работы · работ · работам · работы · работами · работах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Они вставляли ему палки в ___ (колесо, acc. pl.).
exercises.prompt: They put a spoke in his wheel.
exercises.why: **колесо → колеса** (acc. pl.). Neuter, inanimate; nominative plural колёса. Ending -о → -а.  Declension: sg. колесо · колеса · колесу · колесо · колесом · колесе; pl. колёса · колёс · колёсам · колёса · колёсами · колёсах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: В тырнете всяк пишет как бог на ___ (душа, acc. sg.) положит.
exercises.prompt: On the innanet everyone writes as they see fit.
exercises.why: **душа → душу** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. душа · души · душе · душу · душой · душе; pl. души · душ · душам · души · душами · душах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Насекомых влечёт на ___ (свет, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Bugs are attracted to light.
exercises.why: **свет → свет** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. свет · света · свету · свет · светом · свете; pl. — · — · — · — · — · —.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: С деньгами в ___ (данный момент, acc. sg.) напряжно.
exercises.prompt: Money is tight right now.
exercises.why: **момент → момент** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **данный → данный** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with момент). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. момент · момента · моменту · момент · моментом · моменте; pl. моменты · моментов · моментам · моменты · моментами · моментах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

Declension: sg. отмель · отмели · отмели · отмель · отмелью · отмели; pl. отмели · отмелей · отмелям · отмели · отмелями · отмелях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. exercises.q: Я думаю, что в ___ (близкое время, acc. sg.) будет штормить.
exercises.prompt: I think it will storm soon.
exercises.why: **время → время** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -мя. Declines like DLI's имя — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. имя). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **близкий → ближайшее** (acc. sg. n., agreeing with время). «ближайшее» is a degree form (comparative / superlative) of близкий, not its plain form, so no ending is compared with the plain declension.  Declension: sg. время · времени · времени · время · временем · времени; pl. времена · времён · временам · времена · временами · временах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том сел на ___ (свой конь, acc. sg.) и ускакал.
exercises.prompt: Tom mounted his horse and rode off.
exercises.why: **конь → коня** (acc. sg.). Masculine, animate, nominative singular in -ь. Declines like DLI's учитель — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. учителя). Ending -ь → -я.  **свой → своего** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with коня). A possessive — declines like DLI's мой. Ending -й → -его.  Declension: sg. конь · коня · коню · коня · конём · коне; pl. кони · коней · коням · коней · конями · конях.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «Notice the similarity of the endings of the possessives to the form of «они».» мой · моё — моего — моему — моим — о моём; моя — моей — мою; мои — моих — моим — моими — о моих. — DLI, Lessons 47–48.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Он записался в ___ (школьный драмкружок, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: He joined his school's drama club.

No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **школьный → школьный** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with драмкружок). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. драмкружок · драмкружка · драмкружку · драмкружок · драмкружком · драмкружке; pl. драмкружки · драмкружков · драмкружкам · драмкружки · драмкружками · драмкружках.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Будет нетрудно найти арендатора на ___ (этот дом, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: It'll be easy to find someone to rent this house.
exercises.why: **дом → дом** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **этот → этот** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with дом). «этот» is a pronoun-type word with its own declension, not the regular adjective pattern, so no ending rule is claimed. Its forms (m. sg.): этот · этого · этому · этот (inan.) / этого (anim.) · этим · этом.  Declension: sg. дом · дома · дому · дом · домом · доме; pl. дома · домов · домам · дома · домами · домах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я иду на ___ (юго-запад, acc. sg.) деревни.
exercises.prompt: I go to the southwest of the village.
exercises.why: **юго-запад → юго-запад** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. юго-запад · юго-запада · юго-западу · юго-запад · юго-западом · юго-западе; pl. юго-запады · юго-западов · юго-западам · юго-запады · юго-западами · юго-западах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Мы играли в ___ (догонялки, acc. pl.).
exercises.prompt: We played tag.
exercises.why: **догонялки → догонялки** (acc. pl.). A plural-only noun (it has no singular); nominative plural догонялки. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension (plural only): догонялки · догонялок · догонялкам · догонялки · догонялками · догонялках.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «The letter ы never follows г, к, х, ж, ч, ш, щ; therefore: книга — книги, река — реки, госпожа — госпожи.» — DLI, Lesson 23.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Она пыталась подсмотреть в ___ (замочная скважина, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: She was trying to peep through the keyhole.
exercises.why: **скважина → скважину** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  **замочный → замочную** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with скважину). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. новую. Ending -ая → -ую.  Declension: sg. скважина · скважины · скважине · скважину · скважиной · скважине; pl. скважины · скважин · скважинам · скважины · скважинами · скважинах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я наступил на ___ (больная мозоль, acc. sg.)?
exercises.prompt: Did I touch a nerve?
exercises.why: **мозоль → мозоль** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -ь. Declines like DLI's часть — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. часть). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **больной → больную** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with мозоль). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings, apart from the masculine nominative singular (and the inanimate accusative equal to it), which ends in -ой here, not -ый): A. новую. Ending -ая → -ую.  Declension: sg. мозоль · мозоли · мозоли · мозоль · мозолью · мозоли; pl. мозоли · мозолей · мозолям · мозоли · мозолями · мозолях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending -ой if stressed: новый — молодой; русский — плохой, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension.» «The adjective «большой» belongs to the guttural type, in spite of its -ш-: большого, большому, большим, о большом.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
